headline: Thirteen degrees under high thin cloud.
body: The night has settled to thirteen degrees. A west-southwest breeze holds near nine kilometres an hour while pressure remains at one thousand twenty-seven and continues to rise. High thin cloud covers roughly a third of the sky; the streets stay dry beneath the lamps.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: partly cloudy, 13°C, WSW 9 km/h, pressure 1027 rising
